title: Update Rootward Square ground and the town's land round it

result.summary: Restored the pre-flat v6/v3 terraces in ground v5, retaining extended loading, saved offset and layout tools. Recessed only the clockmaker plot; removed sub-mist geometry and fifteen deep placements. Day/night layered mist obscures the bottom. Full suite, fixed-light budget, native loading/layout/stairs and save/archive checks passed.
